# red-on-base starts a runner on a pull request without a changed unit spec

## Context

CI has 20 concurrent runner jobs across the org (operator, 19 Nov 2026), and #20328 aggregated Engine's jobs to fit. On 19 Nov a full Engine PR push started about 35 runner jobs, a `dev` push 26, and a PR body edit 7, merged PRs included. Same-Head Check Repair ran 46 times in about two hours. The operator also noted that many open Engine PRs multiply this, since a merge sends conflicting PRs through CI again.

Scope narrowed 19 Nov, 18:50Z: File Size Guard and Same-Head Check Repair wait on neo-agent-skills#427, so they moved to #21504 and one PR resolves this ticket.

## The Problem

**`red-on-base (advisory)`** (`test.yml`, #21027) runs on every `pull_request` push. It re-runs the PR's changed unit specs against the merge parent's source (#20904), so a PR that changes no unit spec starts a runner that has nothing to run.

Measured and kept: the claim responder runs on every PR event of every author. Its overlap and residual-scope notices apply to a maintainer's PR that targets a held curated issue, and a job-level condition cannot see the target.

## The Architectural Reality

- `test.yml` `red-on-base`: `if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}`. The scope classifier (*Classify test scope*) already knows which files changed.

## The Fix

`red-on-base` runs only when the classifier reports a changed unit spec.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: a PR that changes no unit spec, or nothing outside `test/`, starts no `red-on-base` runner, and a PR that changes both still runs it. The job already skipped the first kind, after its runner had started.

## Out of Scope

- File Size Guard and Same-Head Check Repair: #21504.
- The e2e shard count and ceiling: #21493.
- How precisely the e2e selection picks a PR's specs. It ran the full population on a `src/draggable` change, and whether that is right is a separate question.
- The claim responder (above).
- #21049's recount of `red-on-base`'s value. This ticket changes only when the job starts.

## Avoided Traps

- **Workflow-level `paths` filters for required contexts:** they strand required checks (#20328).

## Related

#20328 · #21027 · #21049 · #21504 (split off) · neo-agent-skills#426 (adding jobs needs a justification)
